panels.title: Available aggregate signal sources (0 = not instrumented)
Meta activity by product (not migration completion)

options.content: Credential health, subscription drift, queue/dead-letter backlog, and projection lag do not currently have a safe global aggregate source. Their availability value is **0 (unknown/unavailable)**, never a zero count. Per-tenant operations diagnostics require authorized tenant context and must not be scraped into global metrics. Do not use this dashboard to authorize migration or cutover. Staging, destination database, and migration-cohort verification are Not confirmed.
